Are you an experienced Character Artist with expertise in stylised character creation, hand‑painted texturing and mobile game development?

This is an exciting contract opportunity to help create the characters, costumes and cosmetic content for a charming, stylised mobile game. You'll play a key role in bringing a vibrant game world to life, creating memorable characters that are full of personality while ensuring assets are optimised for mobile performance and production pipelines.

About the role

You will be responsible for creating high‑quality stylised characters, outfits and cosmetic assets that align with an established visual direction. Working closely with the art team, you'll design and build expressive game‑ready assets for a wide variety of inhabitants, including villagers, NPCs, avatar customisation items and cosmetic variations.

This role combines artistic creativity with technical execution, requiring a strong understanding of stylised art, mobile optimisation and modular asset creation.

What you'll be doing

  • Create stylised 3D characters that fit seamlessly within an established visual style
  • Model and texture villagers, NPCs, avatar costumes and cosmetic items
  • Produce hand‑painted textures with strong colour, material definition and readability
  • Develop modular character assets and cosmetic variations that support customisation systems
  • Create clean, efficient low‑poly models optimised for mobile platforms
  • Sculpt stylised organic forms including hair, clothing and character features
  • Prepare UV layouts and optimise assets for implementation within the game engine
  • Collaborate closely with artists, designers and production teams to maintain visual consistency
  • Iterate on assets based on feedback while maintaining quality and production efficiency
  • Deliver game‑ready assets that meet artistic, technical and performance requirements

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Professional experience as a Character Artist within games
  • Experience creating stylised characters for mobile, casual or family‑friendly titles
  • Experience working within established art styles and visual pipelines
  • Experience delivering game‑ready assets from concept through final implementation

Skills

  • Strong stylised character modelling skills with excellent appeal and personality
  • Expertise in hand‑painted texturing techniques
  • Low‑poly modelling and topology optimisation for mobile platforms
  • Experience creating modular cosmetic systems and character variations
  • Strong UV mapping and asset optimisation skills
  • Excellent understanding of shape language, silhouette and visual readability
  • Experience sculpting stylised organic forms, including hair and clothing
  • Strong drawing and visual development fundamentals
  • Ability to interpret concepts and iterate effectively based on feedback
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with Maya
  • Experience working in Unity
  • Previous experience on mobile games
  • UK‑based location

Working style / behaviours

  • Collaborative and feedback‑driven
  • Passionate about stylised art and character design
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining production efficiency
  • Comfortable working remotely within an established pipeline
  • Proactive and able to take ownership of deliverables

Why join

  • Work on a charming, character‑driven mobile title
  • Opportunity to create a wide variety of stylised characters and cosmetics
  • Flexible remote or hybrid working options
  • Collaborative and creative art team environment
  • High impact role helping define the personality and charm of the game world

Location: Fully Remote
Employment type: Freelance / Contract
Duration: 6 months

If you're a talented Character Artist who loves creating expressive stylised characters and polished mobile‑ready assets, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now or email Joe McKernan - jm@skillsearch.com

Years of experience and salary levels are shown purely as a guide. We will only consider applications from candidates that can demonstrate the skills or experience required for the role.

Please be aware that while we would love to respond to every application we receive, due to high numbers we cannot guarantee this. We do however appreciate any time you invest into the application and will make sure to get in touch should anything in future more closely fit your skillset.

Are you a versatile Game Artist with a passion for creating engaging, polished gameplay visuals and bringing game mechanics to life through art and animation?

We're working with an innovative mobile games studio seeking a Match-3 Game Artist to take ownership of key gameplay content for a new casual puzzle title. This is an exciting opportunity to work across the full asset creation pipeline, from concept through implementation, helping shape the visual identity and player experience of an ambitious new project.

About The Role

As a Match-3 Game Artist, you will take ownership of gameplay blockers and interactive puzzle elements, creating assets from initial concept through to final implementation within Unity.

Working closely with Designers, Art Direction and the wider development team, you'll be responsible for ensuring gameplay elements are visually appealing, clearly communicate gameplay behaviour and contribute to a satisfying player experience.

This is a highly collaborative role with significant ownership, offering the opportunity to influence the visual quality and direction of a growing project. There is also potential for the role to expand into broader ownership across the game's match-3 content and wider art production.

What You'll Do

Asset Creation & Concept Development

  • Conceptualise and develop new match-3 blockers and gameplay elements.
  • Collaborate closely with Design teams to ensure assets support gameplay objectives.
  • Present ideas and visual solutions that enhance the player experience.
  • Iterate on concepts based on feedback from stakeholders and testing.

3D Art Production

  • Create high-quality production-ready assets using Blender.
  • Produce models, textures, materials and shaders suitable for mobile game environments.
  • Ensure assets meet technical and artistic requirements.
  • Maintain a high level of visual quality and consistency across all content.

Animation & Implementation

  • Prepare assets for integration and animation workflows.
  • Create in-engine animations using Unity.
  • Develop:
    • State transitions
    • Destruction sequences
    • Interactive animations
    • Gameplay-driven visual feedback
  • Support the implementation of effects that improve game feel and readability.

Gameplay Readability & Visual Design

  • Design assets that clearly communicate gameplay functionality.
  • Ensure blockers are visually distinct and intuitive for players.
  • Balance creativity with usability and clarity.
  • Contribute to overall gameplay polish and player satisfaction.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Take ownership of assets from concept through final implementation.
  • Work closely with Designers, Artists and Developers.
  • Contribute ideas that evolve and strengthen the existing art style.
  • Support a collaborative and feedback-driven development process.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • Professional experience as a Game Artist.
  • Experience working on mobile, casual or free-to-play titles.
  • Track record of creating gameplay-focused assets.
  • Experience working through a full production pipeline from concept to implementation.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in:
    • Blender
    • Photoshop
    • Unity
  • Experience creating and implementing 3D assets.
  • Experience with in-engine animation workflows.
  • Understanding of materials, shaders and asset optimisation.
  • Knowledge of mobile game art production best practices.

Artistic Skills

  • Strong art fundamentals including:
    • Shape language
    • Colour
    • Composition
    • Readability
    • Visual hierarchy
  • Strong understanding of animation principles and timing.
  • Excellent eye for game feel and gameplay communication.
  • Ability to work within and expand an established visual style.

Personal Qualities

  • Self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Able to balance creativity with gameplay requirements.
  • Comfortable working at pace in an iterative development environment.
  • Passionate about creating polished player experiences.

Nice To Have

  • Experience working on shipped Match-3 or Puzzle titles.
  • Experience creating casual mobile game content.
  • Unity VFX experience.
  • Knowledge of:
    • Particle systems
    • Shaders
    • Gameplay visual effects
  • Experience contributing to visual style development and direction.

Why Join?

  • Work on an exciting new casual mobile game.
  • Own gameplay-critical visual content from concept to completion.
  • Influence the visual quality and player experience of a growing project.
  • Collaborate with a talented multidisciplinary development team.
  • Gain exposure to a broad range of art disciplines including modelling, animation and implementation.
  • Opportunity for increased ownership and long-term involvement as the project evolves.

If you're a creative and technically capable Game Artist who enjoys combining art, animation and gameplay design to create memorable player experiences, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now or email Joe McKernan - jm@skillsearch.com

Are you a talented Video Editor with a passion for games, cinematic storytelling and creating world-class marketing content?

We're seeking an experienced Video Editor to join a leading AAA game development studio, supporting the team behind the next chapter of one of gaming's most beloved fantasy franchises. This is an exciting opportunity to work directly with developers, artists and content creators to bring breath taking game worlds to audiences around the globe.

About The Role

As a Video Editor, you will work closely with the Media and Content teams to create compelling video content that showcases the game, engages players and supports global marketing campaigns.

You'll combine expertise in game capture, cinematography and editing to create high-quality content across a variety of formats, including trailers, promotional videos, social content and internal presentations. From capturing gameplay footage through to delivering polished final assets, you'll play a key role in shaping how players experience and connect with the game before launch and beyond.

This role is ideal for someone who understands both the technical and creative aspects of video production and has a passion for crafting memorable visual stories.

What You'll Do

Game Capture & Content Creation

  • Capture high-quality gameplay footage and screenshots across console, PC and game engine environments.
  • Collaborate with development teams to stage, sequence and capture engaging gameplay moments.
  • Create visually compelling content that highlights key features, mechanics and storytelling moments.
  • Develop content suitable for both internal and external audiences.

Video Editing & Post-Production

  • Edit and produce polished video content using captured gameplay footage.
  • Create marketing materials including:
    • Trailers
    • Promotional videos
    • Social media content
    • Campaign assets
    • Internal showcase materials
  • Apply strong storytelling principles to create engaging narratives and emotional impact.
  • Ensure content aligns with brand standards and creative direction.

Creative Development

  • Work with Content and Marketing teams to define visual styles and creative approaches.
  • Contribute ideas that enhance audience engagement and storytelling.
  • Apply cinematography principles including:
    • Framing
    • Composition
    • Lighting
    • Pacing
    • Visual storytelling
  • Help establish and maintain a consistent visual identity across content.

Review & Refinement

  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback into content revisions.
  • Maintain high standards of quality throughout the production process.
  • Deliver assets that meet project objectives, timelines and creative expectations.
  • Collaborate effectively across multiple disciplines to achieve the best possible outcome.

Industry Awareness

  • Stay informed about evolving content trends, video formats and industry best practices.
  • Continuously seek opportunities to improve production quality and creative effectiveness.
  • Apply new techniques and approaches to enhance content performance.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • Proven professional experience in video editing and post-production.
  • Experience within the games, entertainment, film or media industries.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality video content and storytelling.
  • Experience creating marketing and promotional assets.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced experience with:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Adobe After Effects
    • Adobe Photoshop
    • Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong understanding of professional editing workflows and post-production pipelines.
  • Experience preparing content for multiple channels and formats.
  • Strong understanding of video codecs, exports and delivery requirements.

Capture & Cinematics

  • Expertise in gameplay capture and video production.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Cinematography
    • Camera language
    • Lighting
    • Editorial storytelling
  • Experience capturing content directly from game engines.
  • Ability to identify and showcase compelling gameplay moments.

Desirable Skills

  • Motion graphics and compositing experience.
  • Familiarity with cinematic and sequencing tools, such as:
    • Unreal Engine
    • Unity
    • MotionBuilder
  • Experience working directly with game development teams.
  • Background creating AAA game marketing content.

Personal Qualities

  • Passion for storytelling and visual communication.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong creative instincts and artistic judgment.
  • Collaborative and open to feedback.
  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for games and interactive entertainment.

Success In This Role

  • Marketing videos and trailers effectively showcase the game and engage players.
  • Content consistently reflects high production values and creative excellence.
  • Gameplay capture is cinematic, technically strong and visually compelling.
  • Assets are delivered on time and meet stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaboration across development, marketing and content teams runs smoothly.
  • Content contributes to stronger audience engagement and brand awareness.

Why Join?

  • Work on one of the gaming industry's most iconic fantasy franchises.
  • Collaborate with an award-winning AAA development team.
  • Create content seen by millions of players worldwide.
  • Gain access to state-of-the-art development facilities and technology.
  • Influence how one of the industry's most anticipated titles is presented to the world.
  • Join a passionate, creative and highly collaborative studio environment.

Location: Royal Leamington Spa, UK (Hybrid)
Salary: Up to £45,000 GBP per annum

Are you an experienced Video Artist with strong gameplay capture, cinematic editing and motion graphics skills in Unreal Engine?

Join a creative game development team where you’ll produce high‑quality trailers, gameplay content and in‑engine visuals that showcase games authentically and engagingly. This role is ideal for someone who is both technically skilled and creatively driven, with a passion for bringing gameplay to life through video and visual storytelling.

About the role

You will be responsible for creating and editing gameplay‑driven video content, ensuring all marketing and in‑game materials accurately represent the player experience. Working closely with developers and creative teams, you’ll produce trailers, in‑game visuals and cinematic sequences using engine tools and post‑production workflows. Are you a Character Concept Artist with a talent for creating expressive, stylised characters and a portfolio that demonstrates a strong understanding of established game art styles?

We're recruiting for a Senior Character Concept Artist to support a globally recognised mobile game team, helping create memorable characters that fit within a highly established and beloved visual universe. This is an excellent opportunity to work on a long-running live game with millions of players while collaborating closely with an experienced internal art team.

About The Role

As a Senior Character Concept Artist, you will be responsible for creating high-quality character concepts that seamlessly integrate into an existing stylised art direction.

You'll work closely with Art Directors, Game Designers and fellow artists to develop characters that feel distinctive, readable and consistent with the game's visual language. This role requires someone who can quickly generate ideas, iterate efficiently and confidently incorporate feedback throughout the creative process.

The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of shape language, character appeal, personality-driven design and the requirements of live-service game development.

What You'll Do

Character Concept Development

  • Create high-quality stylised character concepts from initial ideation through final presentation.
  • Design memorable characters with strong silhouettes, personality and readability.
  • Develop concepts that fit seamlessly within an established visual style.
  • Explore variations and iterations to support creative decision-making.

Visual Development

  • Translate design briefs into compelling visual solutions.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in:
    • Shape language
    • Colour theory
    • Character appeal
    • Visual storytelling
    • Proportion and silhouette design
  • Ensure designs remain clear and recognisable at game scale.

Collaboration & Iteration

  • Work closely with internal creative stakeholders throughout development.
  • Present ideas and participate in creative discussions.
  • Iterate quickly based on feedback and evolving project needs.
  • Maintain strong communication while working remotely.

High-Volume Content Creation

  • Deliver concepts efficiently while maintaining quality.
  • Balance creativity with production requirements.
  • Respond to changing priorities and development needs.
  • Support ongoing content creation for a live game environment.

Independent Delivery

  • Manage workload effectively within a freelance/contract environment.
  • Maintain consistent delivery against agreed deadlines.
  • Provide regular updates and communicate progress proactively.
  • Take ownership of assigned tasks from concept through approval.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience

  • Significant experience as a Character Concept Artist within games, animation or entertainment.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing stylised character design.
  • Experience developing production-ready character concepts.
  • Ability to work within an established visual style.
  • Experience collaborating directly with art teams and creative leadership.

Artistic Skills

  • Excellent character design fundamentals.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Anatomy
    • Gesture
    • Character appeal
    • Silhouette design
    • Colour and composition
    • Visual storytelling
  • Ability to create expressive and memorable characters.
  • Strong drawing and rendering skills.

Working Style

  • Comfortable receiving and applying feedback.
  • Able to work quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently.
  • Experience working in remote or distributed teams is advantageous.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience creating artwork for stylised mobile games.
  • Strong understanding of live-service game development.
  • Previous freelance or contract experience.
  • Familiarity with the game's genre, audience and visual style.
  • Active interest in mobile gaming and character-driven products.

Portfolio Requirements

A strong portfolio is essential and should demonstrate:

  • High-quality stylised character concepts.
  • Strong shape language and visual design skills.
  • Character ideation and exploration work.
  • Final presentation-quality designs.
  • Examples showing the ability to adapt to an established art style.

Candidates whose portfolio demonstrates close alignment to the required visual style will be particularly well suited to the role.

Interview Process

As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical art test designed to assess:

  • Style adaptation skills.
  • Character design ability.
  • Visual problem-solving.
  • Speed and quality of execution.
  • Ability to work from an established brief.

Why Join?

  • Work on a globally successful live-service mobile game.
  • Create characters seen by millions of players worldwide.
  • Collaborate with an experienced and highly respected art team.
  • Fully remote engagement with long-term extension potential.
  • Opportunity to contribute creatively while working within a strong, established IP.
  • High level of autonomy and ownership within a supportive team environment.

Contract Length: Initial 6 Months (with potential for long-term extension)
Location: Fully Remote
Travel: Occasional visits to the Helsinki studio
Preferred Time Zone: European or similar working hours
